parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name for which you want to enable DNSSEC. This feature is available only to users of paid Alibaba Cloud DNS.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of DNSSEC. Valid values:

- ON: Enables DNSSEC.

- OFF: Disables DNSSEC.
